summary: Mark up one section of your book at a time and send it for revision.
page_description: Read a section of your manuscript from GitHub, hold a word to highlight, split or move its paragraph, and send your marks to a gateway you run. It revises under your rules, and you keep or discard each change before it is committed.
release_notes: First release: sections, block editing, highlights, outline moves, revision review and commit.

steps.text: Run the Drafter gateway on a computer or server you control, behind HTTPS, with a bearer token. It holds your GitHub and model credentials; the reader never sees them.
Once per reader: with it plugged in over USB, run kobo setup --enable-ssh. Then save it so the commands below find it on Wi-Fi without an address.
Sign Drafter in. The token is checked against the gateway before it is installed, and it only ever works with that gateway.
